book.name: 2 Kolinita
book.title: 2 KOLINITA MeKolinita ꞌidi leta heluwena Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Coinega Yehoba baꞌidamai ꞌapaipaihowa, ta ꞌoimiya ꞌaꞌahwanoi ma sahena ꞌina helau waꞌahwa ginaula bwagabwagae,

content.text: ꞌabihetena ꞌana tuta ꞌoina yaꞌabihete pwaigowa.”

content: Moisa, bewa tuta bwebweꞌana ma ꞌami ꞌabihetena waloba.
Cabihetena bewa tomota mabwaiyadi weyahidi, genuwama ma ꞌaigeda taiya ꞌilolomugiyemai ꞌima paihowao weyahidi. Geya ꞌaigeda wete ꞌebeꞌetoboda ꞌalagulagu,
ma hesi ꞌima paihowao mabwaiyana bwebweꞌana ꞌaheꞌitaeya ꞌabehega Yehoba ꞌina topaihowao bwebweꞌama. Cima paihowa bewa: ꞌalamaꞌiꞌita madouna, muyamuya, miyamwau, hesilae,
sapi, ꞌebepai, ꞌaleha, paihowa, ꞌoyatola masala, gomale,
mumuga ꞌasilalana, sanapu, ꞌatemuyamuya, heꞌiyaꞌiyagu, Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌateda, ta wete helau moisa,
ta ꞌima gwae moisa, ma wete Yehoba ꞌina waiwai ꞌoima, ma ꞌima ꞌebeꞌaleha ꞌebeulaulamega ma ꞌadigeyegeyemega, beno ꞌima mumuga bwebweꞌana.
Tuta tupwana tomota siꞌahwa bwebweꞌanemai ma tuta tupwana siꞌahwa galagalaemai. Wete siꞌahwa ꞌaboꞌabowemai ma hesi geya ꞌaꞌabo.
Tomota geya sisanapumai ma hesi Yehoba ꞌisanapumaiya. Tauma gide ꞌamaꞌamasima ma hesi yawasima ꞌausalana. Siꞌabiꞌabi hegalemaiya ma geya siloheꞌamasimai.

Tauma maꞌima nuwagala ma hesi ꞌatema ꞌayaliyaliyaya. Tauma gide wewelohe, ma hesi wasawasa ꞌaheheguyai tomota baibaiwadi ꞌoidiya. Geya wete ꞌima tobwatobwamo ma hesiyage ginaula mabwaiyana ꞌoima simiyamiya.
Ciyagwao meKolinita ꞌomi, ꞌagu lotohona mabwaiyana yahepwaila latuwa ꞌoimiya,
ta ꞌateguwa yahelauwegomiya, ma hesi geya wayaliyaya ꞌoiguwa.
Coinega natugwao, ꞌilobwaineya ma ꞌatemiyega wahelauwegau.

Sahena watubwetubwegomi taudi geya sihemisa Keliso ꞌoina baꞌidamiyao, weyahina geya sowana mumuga bwebweꞌana ma galana maꞌaigeda wapaihowa. Wete geya sowana ꞌasilala ma guguyou baꞌidana siheꞌiyaꞌiyagu.
Wete geya sowana Keliso ma Tomudulele baꞌidana siheꞌiyaꞌiyagu. Ceguma Kelisoina ꞌuhemiseya, geya sowasowahina tomota taudi geya sihemisa baꞌidamwao wapaihowa mahemahetena.
Wete geya sowasowahina hali ꞌebe hemisao talagu luhuwedi Yehoba ꞌina hada ꞌalona. Yehoba tauna mayawasina ta ꞌina hada tauda, ma ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “‘Taugu taudi ꞌoidiya yaloꞌasa ma ꞌalodiya yayawala dadana ma taugu ꞌidi Yehoba ma taudi ꞌigu tomotao!’
Coinega Yehoba wete ꞌigwaeya, ‘Hali boda ꞌoidiyega walatu ma waꞌebesinedi, ma sahena ginaula biꞌibiꞌidi waꞌabiꞌabitohodi, ma yatoegomi ꞌigu tupwa,
ma ꞌoiguwa waꞌahwa tamana ma ꞌomi natugwao meloheyami ma mewahinemi.’ Bewa Yehoba Tohewaiwai tauna ꞌina gwae.”
